metadata.title: Data Density Pass 15 -- Day 2 Morning Detail (Ticks 226-255)
metadata.description: Individual regiment records for the long July 2 morning of waiting and maneuvering before the afternoon assault. Longstreet's painful delay. Sickles advancing against orders. Berdan's sharpshooters probing Pitzer's Woods. Hood's division reconnaissance. Confederate countermarch. The six hours that Longstreet stalled.

placements.notes: Sickles's III Corps -- supposed to hold Cemetery Ridge. Sickles is dissatisfied with his position.
Humphreys's division in its assigned position on Cemetery Ridge
McLaws's division beginning Longstreet's countermarch -- orders finally given after hours of debate
Hood's division -- Law's brigade has been scouting the Union left all morning
Berdan's sharpshooters probing Pitzer's Woods -- discover Confederates
Berdan's 1st US Sharpshooters -- detect Anderson's division in the woods
Anderson's Confederate skirmishers screening the woods from Berdan
3rd Maine supporting Berdan's withdrawal after the skirmish
Sickles advancing the entire III Corps without orders -- moving to the Emmitsburg Road
Humphreys following Sickles's unauthorized advance
III Corps deployed along the Emmitsburg Road in an exposed salient -- the Peach Orchard line
Humphreys's 2.5 miles of thin line -- no support on either flank
McLaws behind Seminary Ridge -- Longstreet still finalizing deployment
Hood's division behind Seminary Ridge -- Law reports Big Round Top is unoccupied
Law's reconnaissance -- discovers Big Round Top unoccupied and urges flanking movement
Barnes's V Corps division moving to support the endangered III Corps
Ayres's V Corps division in reserve
McLaws finally in position behind Warfield Ridge -- Longstreet gives the order to advance
Hood in position -- Hood begs Longstreet three times to allow a flanking movement. Denied.
Crawford's Pennsylvania Reserves -- waiting at the base of Little Round Top
Sedgwick's VI Corps still arriving -- they marched 35 miles in 17 hours
Hood's division about to step off -- the assault begins at 4 PM
McLaws about to charge -- the Wheatfield, Devil's Den, and Peach Orchard await
